findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_agent · Private data: pathways_session, check_agent, find_agent, find_services, pathways_routes, pathways_delegates, pathways_authorize, pathways_run, pathways_ledger, buy_pass · Public sink: pathways_plan, check_agent, pathways_delegates, stats, buy_pass · Destructive: pathways_prompt, pathways_authorize, pathways_run, pathways_ledger, list_agents.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_agent · Private data: pathways_session, check_agent, find_agent, find_services, pathways_routes, pathways_delegates, pathways_authorize, pathways_run, pathways_ledger, buy_pass · Public sink: pathways_plan, check_agent, pathways_delegates, stats, buy_pass · Destructive: pathways_prompt, pathways_authorize, pathways_run, pathways_ledger, list_agents

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
